## Hispanic or Latino Share Across Sarasota County Tracts

This interactive choropleth map displays the percentage of **Hispanic or Latino** residents (`B03002_012E / B03002_001E`) across all **`r sarasota_summary$n_tracts` census tracts** in Sarasota County, Florida, using official **2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line cartographic boundaries**.

- **Hover** over any census tract to see its population counts, 90% margin of error, and full racial/ethnic breakdown.
- **Switch basemaps** in the top-right corner between *Light Basemap*, *Street Map*, and *Satellite*.

::: {.viz-card}
```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
build_hispanic_map()
```
:::

## Highest-Concentration Census Tracts

While Hispanic or Latino residents represent **`r sprintf("%.2f%%", sarasota_summary$hispanic_pct)`** (`r comma(sarasota_summary$hispanic_pop)` residents) of Sarasota County overall, several northern and central Sarasota census tracts have substantially higher shares—led by **`r sarasota_summary$max_hispanic_tract$tract_label`** at **`r sprintf("%.1f%%", sarasota_summary$max_hispanic_tract$pct_hispanic)`**.

::: {.viz-card}
```{r}
build_top_tracts_chart()
```
:::
